name: Frost on the hood
notes: Played by FS47Attention (S47Attention.cpp, N1110) when the truck will not start (S47World's key stall): the key, a few turns. Two more ceiling tubes go out in the control room (tube beat, next 2).

beats.text: Frost on the hood. On a night like this.
At {clock} the truck would not start. There was frost on the hood and nowhere else, and the cab smelled like hot wiring.
